spec2def(xolehlp.dll xolehlp.spec)

# xolehlp.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xolehlp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(xolehlp_shims OBJECT xolehlp.c)
target_link_libraries(xolehlp_shims PRIVATE adsiid uuid wine oldnames libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(xolehlp_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE
add_cargo_module(xolehlp xolehlp-cargo xolehlp.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xolehlp_shims psdk uuid_sources)
